assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Co-authoring an existing strategy document with preserved argument, added sections, and revision notes.
assessments.rationale: This is an annual company-planning process, not a revision workflow for an existing strategy document.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A revised strategy document that preserves its argument and includes revision notes.
assessments.rationale: It generates Slidev presentation projects rather than co-authoring and revising a strategy document.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Strategy-document-specific restructuring and addition of missing sections.
assessments.rationale: It preserves an existing draft and supplies a change log, but it is limited to fiction prose and disallows drafting missing material or structural rebuilding.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Revision and co-authoring of a strategy document.
assessments.rationale: It identifies software test-coverage gaps and produces a test plan, not a revised document.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Revision and co-authoring of a strategy document.
assessments.rationale: It analyzes public-company analyst estimates and revision trends, not document structure or revision notes.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Preservation of the existing argument and revision notes for the co-authored document.
assessments.rationale: It can structure a strategy brief and add report sections, but it frames the work as producing a report and does not provide an existing-document revision workflow or revision notes.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Revision and co-authoring of a strategy document.
assessments.rationale: It runs gene-set enrichment analysis and produces scientific analysis outputs, not a revised strategy document.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A strategy-document-specific workflow for adding missing sections and retaining revision notes.
assessments.rationale: It can preserve an existing argument while polishing or restructuring prose, but it is scoped to academic writing and does not define the requested strategy-document revision deliverable.
